title: Chocolate Beignets
description: Light, crispy yeasted dough pockets fried until puffed and golden — filled with hazelnut chocolate spread and dusted with icing sugar.
description_ms: Adunan ragi yang ringan dan crispy digoreng sehingga kembang dan keemasan — diisi dengan coklat hazelnut dan ditaburi gula serbuk.
steps: Combine 3/4 cup warm water and 1 packet yeast; wait 5 minutes.
Add 0.5 cup evaporated milk, 1/3 cup sugar, 3 tbsp melted butter, 1 tsp vanilla essence, 1 egg and 0.5 tsp salt; mix well.
Add 4 cup all-purpose flour and knead until smooth and non-sticky. Cover and rest for 1 hour.
After rising, lightly knock back; dust a board with flour and roll the dough thin.
Cut into squares; re-roll any scraps.
Deep-fry in hot oil in batches until puffed and golden. Drain.
Optionally fill with chocolate hazelnut spread (press into the dough square before frying, or pipe in after).
Dust generously with icing sugar and serve warm.
steps_ms: Campurkan 3/4 cawan air suam dan 1 paket yis; tunggu 5 minit.
Masukkan setengah cawan susu sejat, 1/3 cawan gula, 3 sudu butter cair, 1 sudu kecil esen vanila, 1 biji telur dan setengah sudu kecil garam; gaul sebati.
Masukkan 4 cawan tepung gandum dan uli sehingga licin dan tidak melekat. Tutup dan rehat 1 jam.
Lepas kembang, lenyek keluar udara; tabur tepung di papan dan lenyekkan doh sehingga nipis.
Potong jadi petak-petak; gulung balik lebihan.
Goreng dalam minyak panas sehingga kembang dan keemasan. Toskan.
Boleh isi dengan coklat hazelnut (letakkan dalam petak sebelum goreng, atau paipkan masuk selepas).
Taburi banyak gula serbuk dan hidang panas.
